AGRICULTURAL_ORIGINS_CAUTION.source: Gremillion et al. 2014 Particularism and theory in agricultural origins
AGRICULTURAL_ORIGINS_CAUTION.use: broad-spectrum change and optimal-foraging mechanisms are regionally variable and not a single universal transition

BROAD_SPECTRUM_REVIEW.source: Stiner 2001 Thirty years on the Broad Spectrum Revolution
BROAD_SPECTRUM_REVIEW.use: diet breadth and intensification can expand before food production and should not be equated with agriculture

DOMESTICATION_PROCESS_REVIEW.source: Kantar et al. 2018 Genomic approaches for studying crop evolution
DOMESTICATION_PROCESS_REVIEW.use: domestication should be treated as a prolonged evolutionary process with gene flow and multiple stages

LAND_USE_INTENSIFICATION.source: Ellis et al. 2013 Used planet: a global history
LAND_USE_INTENSIFICATION.use: late-Pleistocene foragers can intensify land and resource use before agriculture

MULTIREGIONAL_CULTIVATION.source: Arranz-Otaegui et al./Riehl-related 2016 regional diversity in early cultivation
MULTIREGIONAL_CULTIVATION.use: cultivation and domestication trajectories vary regionally and can proceed in parallel

PROTRACTED_DOMESTICATION.source: Fuller et al. 2017 Geographic mosaics and changing rates of cereal domestication
PROTRACTED_DOMESTICATION.use: domestication is protracted, geographically mosaic and cannot be represented as an instantaneous threshold

PUNCTUATED_SUBSISTENCE.source: Weitzel & Codding 2015 Toward a theory of punctuated subsistence change
PUNCTUATED_SUBSISTENCE.use: landscape management, storage and decreased mobility may precondition but do not guarantee food production

SEDENTISM_BEFORE_DOMESTICATION.source: Fuller et al. 2014 Convergent evolution and parallelism in plant domestication
SEDENTISM_BEFORE_DOMESTICATION.use: sedentism or persistent sites can predate morphological domestication

STORAGE_RISK_BUFFERING.source: Rowley-Conwy & Zvelebil, storage by prehistoric hunter-gatherers
STORAGE_RISK_BUFFERING.use: storage is a risk-buffering strategy and not synonymous with agriculture
